fields.name: EffectHandler
fields.evidence: SE already declares ecl::EffectHandler (GameDefinitions/Effect.h, 0x130 bytes) and the live sample matches it field by field: VMT at +0, InitInfo.TargetEffect.Entity at +0x60, its Position at +0x68 (45.47, 17, -420.8), Flags at +0x88 (3), MultiEffectDefinition STDString at +0xA0 (size 0x24 at +0xB0), WeaponBones null FixedString at +0xB8, FXScale 1.0 at +0xBC, MultiEffectInfo resource with VMT at +0xD8 and inline name 'Red_BodyFX' at +0xF0, ConditionalEffects array at +0x120. bg3.exe+0x1EFB990 (hit VFX setup) tests IsActive at component+0x118 and calls ecl::EffectHandler::Destroy (bg3.exe+0x1C73F60) on the component pointer, then re-inits it (bg3.exe+0x1C73DC0).

fields.name: EffectHandler2
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1EFD2A0 uses component+0x130 as an EffectHandler (writes TextKeyEventManager/EffectManager/ResourceManager at +0x138/+0x140/+0x148, IsActive at +0x248). bg3.exe+0x6D8280 (ImmediateWorldCache add) constructs two EffectHandlers at +0 and +0x130 (bg3.exe+0x1C73C90 twice) and destroys both. Live: same VMT at +0x130 as at +0, MultiEffectInfo VMT at +0x208.

fields.name: field_260
